whoIsGraewe.title: Graewe is a sought-after brand in the world of extrusion technology.
whoIsGraewe.subtitle: Because we know how to turn ideas into practice.
whoIsGraewe.p1: For over 40 years, we have been a key driving force in the modern plastics industry in the planning, development, manufacturing, and assembly of plants, machines, and successor machines. With creative and effective concepts and solutions, we have developed into one of the leading suppliers of extrusion machines on the world market.
whoIsGraewe.p2: Our customers particularly appreciate the individual, benefit-oriented concepts and solutions that we competently implement with an excellent price-performance ratio.
whoIsGraewe.p3: The success of our products and services, as well as the success of our customers and partners, confirms our commitment to consistently customer-oriented thinking and action.

whatDoesGraewe.title: Graewe is a competent partner for the modern plastics industry.
whatDoesGraewe.subtitle: Because we have the right solution for almost every application.
whatDoesGraewe.p1: The Graewe product range is as diverse as the tasks that need to be mastered in the plastics processing industry.
whatDoesGraewe.p2: You will find special know-how with us in the field of machine technology for pipes, profiles, and sheets.
whatDoesGraewe.p3: Flexibility and reliability of the technology are guarantees with which Graewe has made a name for itself in recent years. Whether special multifunctionality, space-saving solutions, or very specific requirement profiles: you will always benefit from Graewe's tailor-made results.

whatDoesGraeweStandFor.title: Graewe stands for profitability, flexibility, and reliability.
whatDoesGraeweStandFor.subtitle: Because cost-effectiveness comes first for our customers.
whatDoesGraeweStandFor.p1: We deliver machines that can be adapted to individual needs while avoiding unnecessary costs - with high output rates, low maintenance and service costs, long service life with optimal operating performance, process reliability, and short development times.

graeweGroup.title: The Graewe Group
graeweGroup.subtitle: A strong network for your requirements.
graeweGroup.p1: GRAEWE GmbH was founded in 1981 and develops, designs and manufactures downstream extrusion equipment for pipe and profile production.
graeweGroup.p2: We also deal in the buying and selling of used machines for the plastics industry. For this purpose, the company next, Neuenburger Extrusionstechnik GmbH, was founded.

maplast.text: It is not easy to find an honest source in the world specially for used equipment and when I started to look for second hand extrusion machines in Europe and I searched all around but finally I was very lucky since I choosed Graewe from the start, they gave me that good feeling to go ahead from the start considering that I was in South America and I was not able to fly to Europe all the time so I needed a company I could rely on blind which is not easy since there are many pirates out there in the market only looking at your pocket. This happened quite a long time ago and along the years besides the commercial link we have established a close personal relationship so I can totally rely on their technical capacity and honesty and in some cases when they do not have what you need they will help you to find a source without any further interest at all. Graewe is the kind of company hard to find you can deal directly with the owners, the respond quickly to your requirements big or small, technically capable, fair prices, responsible, honest. I would give them the highest 5 star rating. Finally my very personal opinion is that behind all this there is a fantastic family with all the required values to make them one of the best companies in Germany on whatever plastic business you start or plan to develop.
maplast.author: David Lebed

asg.text: Throughout the past few years in doing business with Graewe/Next machines, they were never short of exceeding our expectations. Their professional team were very punctual and never compromised the quality of their delivered goods. Personally, the flexibility of the management team and their understanding to the needs of the customers were paramount. Costumed solutions were always available which made things much easier in buying decisions. It has always been a pleasure buying from Graewe and will always be.
asg.author: Ahmed A. Alsharif, Chairman & CEO

jobs.title: Job Openings
intro: Dear applicants, we are pleased that you are interested in working at Graewe GmbH.

For more than 40 years we have been a key driver in planning, development, manufacturing and assembly of extrusion lines for the modern plastics industry. With creative, effective concepts and solutions we have become one of the leading suppliers on the world market. We are a family business with 75 long-term employees at our site in Neuenburg am Rhein.
We are among the best in our industry and continually seek committed, motivated colleagues.
Competence, creativity and a willingness to take responsibility are strong foundations for delivering outstanding results for our customers as a team.

items.title: Extended portfolio and expert knowledge
items.excerpt: New collaboration with GRAEWE — extrusion downstream equipment for medium and large profiles with Thomas Neuhardt and Forsch Elektro Service.

body.text: GRAEWE takes on new tasks in the domain of extrusion downstream equipment, namely the average-sized and large profiles / Thomas Neuhardt responsible for the new field of activities / GRAEWE was able to win FORSCH Elektro Service as a partner.

Neuenburg, 20 September 2013: In August 2013, the Neuenburg business company GRAEWE GmbH, leading manufacturer of extrusion downstream equipment for thermoplastic pipes, profiles and sheets, launched into operations with a new team of experts. Their aim is to comprehensively expand sales and service activities in new profile extrusion downstream business.
Two leading personalities were recruited for this specialist segment. Thomas Neuhardt, with GRAEWE since August, as well as Karl-Heinz Forsch from Forsch Elektro Service.

Mr. Neuhardt will concentrate on construction and development. The Forsch Elektro Service team, having acquired know-how from Baston, supplier of spare parts and service for Baston/Vobau systems, has gained expert knowledge in constructive and electrotechnical extrusion.

Market leader GRAEWE can now manufacture and further develop systems of the firm BASTON, which became bankrupt in 2011. Thus, service and supply can now be continued for existing customers of this company!

Initial reactions show that GRAEWE’s concept works: several large orders in the shortest possible time prove that the combination of GRAEWE’s expertise and two experienced, specialized profile extrusion experts is much in demand in the market.
Technology CEO Michael Graewe considers the portfolio extension to be an important strategic decision that ensures even more the future strength of the Neuenburg machine manufacturer.

Stefan Graewe puts it in concrete terms: "We are already seeing that this additional closeness to the customer and better service fills a gap and can become an additional sales guarantee," commented the managing director responsible for the overall sales.
In the meantime, the new team of experts is already on its way to customers and prospective clients to introduce itself and the extended range of services, personally.

items.title: Construction boom boosts demand
items.excerpt: GRAEWE GmbH has acquired a fourth production hall at its Neuenburg site.

body.text: NEUENBURG AM RHEIN. Im Bereich innovativer Extrusionstechnik gehört die Neuenburger Firma Graewe GmbH zu den führenden Herstellern auf dem Weltmarkt. Sie plant, entwickelt und fertigt komplette Extrusionsanlagen, mit denen Kunststoffrohre, -profile und -platten hergestellt werden. Mit dem Kauf einer vierten Produktionshalle hat die Firma ihre Produktionsfläche um ein Drittel auf rund 18 000 Quadratmeter erweitert.

Die Firma hat das gegenüberliegende 6400 Quadratmeter große Grundstück in der Fischerstraße – ehemals Pharmakonzern Biokirch – gekauft mit einer überbauten Büro- und Hallenfläche von 3000 Quadratmetern. Die Betriebserweiterung sei angesichts des stetig steigenden Auftragsvolumens eine wichtige Produktionsgrundlage und diene der Sicherung der Arbeitsplätze. Gleichzeitig sei diese Investition auch „ein klares Bekenntnis zum Standort Neuenburg“, betont Marketing-Geschäftsführer Stefan Graewe. Den Technikbereich leitet sein Bruder Michael Graewe.

Vater Kurt Graewe, Seniorchef und Entwickler von mehreren Patenten, hat die Firma 1981 gegründet. Bevor der Neubau für sein Unternehmen 1987 fertig war, hat er für seinen Betrieb vorübergehend genau das Firmenareal angemietet, das er jetzt käuflich erworben hat. „So schließt sich der Kreis“, sagt Kurt Graewe. Mit zwei Leuten hat er den Aufbau damals begonnen, heute beschäftigt die Firma 85 Mitarbeiter. Graewe-Maschinen – jährlich 180 Stück – werden für Installations- und Bewässerungssysteme, für Fußbodenheizungen, Fensterprofile, aber auch in der Medizin verwendet.

Neben den neuen Maschinen werden aber auch gebrauchte aufgearbeitet und verkauft. Dieser Secondhand-Service für die Kunststoffindustrie läuft über die Graewe-Tochterfirmen Next in Neuenburg und Indext in Mulhouse. Seit 2003 gibt es auch „Graewe-Fangli“ in Ningbo-Schanghai für die steigende Nachfrage im asiatischen Raum.
Trotz der vollen Auftragsbücher sei der Exportanteil auf 80 Prozent gesunken, sagt Stefan Graewe, denn: „Wir profitieren vom Bauboom und der deshalb verstärkten Nachfrage in Deutschland.“
Zugenommen habe auch der Export innerhalb Europas und neben Indien, China, Ägypten, Iran und Russland sei der Verkauf nach Südamerika „im Kommen“, erklärt Stefan Graewe.

items.title: Production halls expanded
items.excerpt: GRAEWE/next expands production space in Neuenburg to a total of 17,800 m² across four halls.

body.text: Die GRAEWE/next GmbH investiert weiter in den Standort Neuenburg. Mit dem Kauf einer weiteren Produktionshalle trägt das Unternehmen dem ungebremst steigenden Auftragsvolumen Rechnung und erweitert die Produktionsfläche in nunmehr vier Hallen um 6.800 qm Grundfläche auf insgesamt 17.800 qm. GRAEWE/next sieht die Erweiterung nicht nur als klares Bekenntnis zum Standort Neuenburg, sondern auch und vor allem als Produktionsgrundlage zur Umsetzung des Auftragswachstums.

„Unsere Auftragsbücher sind voll, GRAEWE-Maschinen sind weltweit gefragt, da sie in Sachen Zuverlässigkeit, Technologie und Produktivität zur Branchenspitze zählen. Wir wollen diesen Trend nicht nur nutzen, sondern ausbauen, indem wir erweiterte Produktionskapazitäten schaffen und nutzen“, erläutert Geschäftsführer Michael Graewe. Und ergänzt, dass man schließlich auch zukünftig keinen Auftrag aus Platzgründen verlieren möchte.

Stefan Graewe, für Marketing und Vertrieb verantwortlicher Geschäftsführer, rechnet mit weiteren Zuwächsen und einer noch stärkeren Internationalisierung: „Es zeigt sich steigendes Interesse vor allem von Seiten vieler Unternehmen aus jenen Staaten, die bislang ausschließlich auf den Preis geachtet haben, nun aber erkennen, dass sie bei Graewe hervorragende Qualität zu fairen Preisen bekommen. Auch für diesen Trend sind wir nun in Neuenburg bestens gerüstet.“
